title: Halo Dental product showcase
description: 12-column hardware feature section on warm stone paper: a 4-column specification stack on the left (64px heading, body copy, 4 hairline-bordered spec rows with icons, and an orange CTA button) paired with a 670×670 square media frame and a 3-thumbnail selector strip on the right.
notes: Pass media and thumbnails props to replace the default studio square and thumbnail placeholders
Thumbnails sit in a vertical column to the right of the main square on desktop and in a horizontal row below it on phones
